what: Independent re-download and re-processing of the forecasting data in the development container, compared with the workstation run of 2026-10-20

download.note: events_current is a live feed (workstation 9,137); collisions after June are empty (publication lag), as on the workstation

limitations: The feature archive checksum covers the compressed .npz file, which embeds archive metadata, and the workstation arrays are not in the repository, so array contents could not be compared directly; the preprocessed grid checksum differs for the same reason. Row counts, grid statistics, graph hash, feature schema hash and split boundaries are identical.
